CXA programming language for native software

An experimental language with familiar syntax, object-oriented features, and a compiler that generates C for native builds.

Get started
Learn CX

Familiar syntax

Write CX with C-style declarations, expressions, and control flow.

Types and abstractions

Explore classes, structs, interfaces, properties, and an evolving generics implementation.

Native toolchain

The compiler emits C and CMake build files and can invoke a native build.

Experimental project

CX is under active development. Features, generated-code ABI, and compatibility guarantees may change.

public int Main(string[] args) {
